You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]

- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident involving the indexer on 2025-10-24. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]

- The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16 during INC-2026-009. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08 during INC-2026-003. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]

    earlier: Farah is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-03-31. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-31]
- Notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04 during incident INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-03-06 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without an idempotency key. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds as follow-up to INC-2025-004. [decision; valid 2025-03-06 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017. [decision; valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
